S.FORM: iiku makasi-ini ia, tee=pa=ku pu-a-iisua sua karianumai kisa-ən=ta.
S.PHON: iiku makaʂiini ia teepaku puaiisua sua karianumai kisaənta
S.FORM: iiku makasiini ia, teepaku puaiisua sua karianumai kisaenta.
S.PHON: iiku makaʂiini ia teepaku puaiisua sua ka[r|ɾ]ianumai kisaenta
S.TRANSL: I shall continue talking about pangolins now.

FORM.notes: Source parenthetical expanded under POL-026/POL-027; exact source and decision are in source_notation_audit.csv.

S.FORM: sua iiku makasi-ini ia, tee=pa=ku pu-a-iisua sua karianumai kisa-ən=ta.
S.PHON: sua iiku makaʂiini ia teepaku puaiisua sua karianumai kisaənta
S.FORM: sua iiku makasiini ia, teepaku puaiisua sua karianumai kisaenta.
S.PHON: sua iiku makaʂiini ia teepaku puaiisua sua ka[r|ɾ]ianumai kisaenta
S.TRANSL: I shall continue talking about pangolins now.

S.FORM: sii sua karianumai iisi ia, cu-cculu kaʔan taavalaʔ-ən t<um>ani-ulaʔə.
S.PHON: ʂii sua karianumai iiʂi ia ʦuʦʦuɾu kaʔan taavaɾaʔən tumaniuɾaʔə
S.FORM: sii sua karianumai iisi ia, cuccuru ka'an taavara'en t<um>aniura'e.
S.PHON: ʂii sua ka[r|ɾ]ianumai iiʂi ia ʦuʦʦu[r|ɾ]u kaʔan taava[r|ɾ]aʔen tumaniu[r|ɾ]aʔe
S.TRANSL: We really cannot abuse pangolins.

S.FORM: si masi-raru ni-pa-pa-taa-ŋanai ma-maaraŋ miana. kaʔan taavalaʔ-ən t<um>ani-ulaʔə misai.
S.PHON: ʂi maʂiraru nipapataaŋanai mamaaraŋ miana kaʔan taavaɾaʔən tumaniuɾaʔə misai
S.FORM: si masiraru nipapataanganai mamaarang miana. ka'an taavara'en t<um>aniura'e misai.
S.PHON: ʂi maʂi[r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]u nipapataaŋanai mamaa[r|ɾ]aŋ miana kaʔan taava[r|ɾ]aʔen tumaniu[r|ɾ]aʔe misai
S.TRANSL: Because our elders in the past might name them, and so they could not abuse them.

S.FORM: sii sua karianumai ia, tee=pa=kamu tuuturu-un.
S.PHON: ʂii sua karianumai ia teepakamu tuuturuun
S.FORM: sii sua karianumai ia, teepakamu tuuturuun.
S.PHON: ʂii sua ka[r|ɾ]ianumai ia teepakamu tuutu[r|ɾ]uun
S.TRANSL: You still have to learn about pangolins.

S.FORM: sua ni-pasi-ʔulu=maku ia, makai sua ni-ara-aka=cu miana kanakanavu ni-ari-takarə karianumai.
S.PHON: sua nipaʂiʔuɾumaku ia makai sua niaraakaʦu miana kanakanavu niaritakarə karianumai
S.FORM: sua nipasi'urumaku ia, makai sua niaraakacu miana kanakanavu niaritakare karianumai.
S.PHON: sua nipaʂiʔu[r|ɾ]umaku ia makai sua nia[r|ɾ]aakaʦu miana kanakanavu nia[r|ɾ]itaka[r|ɾ]e ka[r|ɾ]ianumai
S.TRANSL: I have talked about a pangolin that revived a dead person.

S.FORM: sua makasi-ini ia, tee=cu karanaana.
S.PHON: sua makaʂiini ia teeʦu karanaana
S.FORM: sua makasiini ia, teecu karanaana.
S.PHON: sua makaʂiini ia teeʦu ka[r|ɾ]anaana
S.TRANSL: (I) shall, therefore, (tell) a different story now.

S.FORM: nain sua vanai=mita kaʔan tia=t<um>a-tani-ulaʔə karianumai misai sua kanakanavu miana.
S.PHON: nain sua vanaimita kaʔan tiatumataniuɾaʔə karianumai misai sua kanakanavu miana
S.FORM: nain sua vanaimita ka'an tiat<um>ataniura'e karianumai misai sua kanakanavu miana.
S.PHON: nain sua vanaimita kaʔan tiatumataniu[r|ɾ]aʔe ka[r|ɾ]ianumai misai sua kanakanavu miana
S.TRANSL: Our people in the past gave the reason why we should not abuse any pangolins.

S.FORM: miana ia, taavalaʔə=cu ʔaisi mia-iisua ia, c<um>a-caən=cu=pi=kita puusiam.
S.PHON: miana ia taavaɾaʔəʦu ʔaiʂi miaiisua ia ʦumaʦaənʦupikita puuʂiam
S.FORM: miana ia, taavara'ecu 'aisi miaiisua ia, c<um>acaencupikita puusiam.
S.PHON: miana ia taava[r|ɾ]aʔeʦu ʔaiʂi miaiisua ia ʦumaʦaenʦupikita puuʂiam
S.TRANSL: They already knew how to plant rice paddies at that time.

S.FORM: mia-iisua ia, uncou ciina mintou, na=ʔucaŋ tumuzo, piiʔi, piiʔi na=cuma ʔuna.
S.PHON: miaiisua ia unʦou tʂiina mintou naʔuʦaŋ tumu*o piiʔi piiʔi naʦuma ʔuna
S.FORM: miaiisua ia, uncou ciina mintou, na'ucang tumuzo, pii'i, pii'i nacuma 'una.
S.PHON: miaiisua ia unʦou tʂiina mintou naʔuʦaŋ tumu*o piiʔi piiʔi naʦuma ʔuna
S.TRANSL: At that time, she was Mintou's mother and Tumuzo's wife, and Pii'i's father were still around.

S.FORM: mu-a-kusa=pa avulasiin mia-iisua m-i-nana.
S.PHON: muakusapa avuɾaʂiin miaiisua minana
S.FORM: muakusapa avurasiin miaiisua minana.
S.PHON: muakusapa avu[r|ɾ]aʂiin miaiisua minana
S.TRANSL: She was going to the fields to drive away birds at that time.

S.FORM: mu-kusa ʔinia m-i-nana mu-a-cəməcəmə sua m-i-nana.
S.PHON: mukusa ʔinia minana muaʦəməʦəmə sua minana
S.FORM: mukusa 'inia minana muacemeceme sua minana.
S.PHON: mukusa ʔinia minana muaʦemeʦeme sua minana
S.TRANSL: She got up early in the morning to get therre to drive away birds.

S.FORM: maica=pa siipaar-a mia-iisua cipaku iisua, ʔakia=pa ootobai mia-iisua.
S.PHON: maiʦapa ʂiipaara miaiisua tʂipaku iisua ʔakiapa ooto*ai miaiisua
S.FORM: maicapa siipaara miaiisua cipaku iisua, 'akiapa ootobai miaiisua.
S.PHON: maiʦapa ʂiipaa[r|ɾ]a miaiisua tʂipaku iisua ʔakiapa ooto*ai miaiisua
S.TRANSL: She walked across the river at Cipaku, as there was no motorcycle at that time.

S.FORM: ʔakia=pa torakku ka-vaŋvaŋ.
S.PHON: ʔakiapa torakku kavaŋvaŋ
S.FORM: 'akiapa torakku kavangvang.
S.PHON: ʔakiapa to[r|ɾ]akku kavaŋvaŋ
S.TRANSL: No one had a truck.

S.FORM: ʔərə-kəkə=pa muu-caaca.
S.PHON: ʔərəkəkəpa muuʦaaʦa
S.FORM: 'erekekepa muucaaca.
S.PHON: ʔe[r|ɾ]ekekepa muuʦaaʦa
S.TRANSL: (People had to) still use their legs.

S.FORM: mia-iisua ia, ni-m-ətəa maanu karianumai sua naa=piiʔi pati-saaʔ-ai ʔinia.
S.PHON: miaiisua ia nimətəa maanu karianumai sua naapiiʔi patisaaʔai ʔinia
S.FORM: miaiisua ia, nimetea maanu karianumai sua naapii'i patisaa'ai 'inia.
S.PHON: miaiisua ia nimetea maanu ka[r|ɾ]ianumai sua naapiiʔi patisaaʔai ʔinia
S.TRANSL: Pii'i found a little pangolin and caught it.

S.FORM: um-avici canaa-ini tu-ʔunaʔ-iini m-i-nana.
S.PHON: umavitʂi ʦanaaini tuʔunaʔiini minana
S.FORM: umavici canaaini tu'una'iini minana.
S.PHON: umavitʂi ʦanaaini tuʔunaʔiini minana
S.TRANSL: She brought it to the place (field hut) where she was to chase away birds.

S.FORM: pata-kaur-un=kani=kiai uuru a-pa-kaən.
S.PHON: patakaurunkanikiai uuru apakaən
S.FORM: patakaurunkanikiai uuru apakaen.
S.PHON: patakau[r|ɾ]unkanikiai uu[r|ɾ]u apakaen
S.TRANSL: She filled rice (in a bowl) to feed it.

S.FORM: ruu-ru-vana avic-ai ʔinia taanaasa.
S.PHON: ruuruvana aviʦai ʔinia taanaasa
S.FORM: ruuruvana avicai 'inia taanaasa.
S.PHON: [r|ɾ]uu[r|ɾ]uvana aviʦai ʔinia taanaasa
S.TRANSL: She brought it home in the evening.

S.FORM: mia-iisua ia, ʔuuna=pi=kimi cuuma mia-iisua. cuma miciko cumpouli kisa-ən. iisua ia, ma-sətan ʔaisi na kanakanavu maaraŋ.
S.PHON: miaiisua ia ʔuunapikimi ʦuuma miaiisua ʦuma mitʂiko ʦumpouɾi kisaən iisua ia masətan ʔaiʂi na kanakanavu maaraŋ
S.FORM: miaiisua ia, 'uunapikimi cuuma miaiisua. cuma miciko cumpouri kisaen. iisua ia, masetan 'aisi na kanakanavu maarang.
S.PHON: miaiisua ia ʔuunapikimi ʦuuma miaiisua ʦuma mitʂiko ʦumpou[r|ɾ]i kisaen iisua ia masetan ʔaiʂi na kanakanavu maa[r|ɾ]aŋ
S.TRANSL: At that time our elder was still living. Michiko's father named Cumpouli was the oldest (in the village).

S.FORM: tuuturu-ai ʔikua u-kusa-ai ʔinia na piiʔi.
S.PHON: tuuturuai ʔikua ukusaai ʔinia na piiʔi
S.FORM: tuuturuai 'ikua ukusaai 'inia na pii'i.
S.PHON: tuutu[r|ɾ]uai ʔikua ukusaai ʔinia na piiʔi
S.TRANSL: I told him and he went to Pii'i.

S.FORM: "pali-a-uluŋ-au, ʔakuni paka-iisi-ai."
S.PHON: paɾiauɾuŋau ʔakuni pakaiiʂiai
S.FORM: "pariaurungau, 'akuni pakaiisiai."
S.PHON: pa[r|ɾ]iau[r|ɾ]uŋau ʔakuni pakaiiʂiai
S.TRANSL: "Untie it! Don't do it!"

S.FORM: "puisia," kisa-ən=kiai. kaʔan paki-turu. u-kusa-ai ʔinia tuu-tasiʔar-ini.
S.PHON: puiʂia kisaənkiai kaʔan pakituru ukusaai ʔinia tuutaʂiʔarini
S.FORM: "puisia," kisaenkiai. ka'an pakituru. ukusaai 'inia tuutasi'arini.
S.PHON: puiʂia kisaenkiai kaʔan pakitu[r|ɾ]u ukusaai ʔinia tuutaʂiʔa[r|ɾ]ini
S.TRANSL: "It's a superstituion," she said. She didn't agree. She went there in the morning.

S.FORM: c<um>əʔəra, ʔaisi=pa ʔinia.
S.PHON: ʦuməʔəra ʔaiʂipa ʔinia
S.FORM: c<um>e'era, 'aisipa 'inia.
S.PHON: ʦumeʔe[r|ɾ]a ʔaiʂipa ʔinia
S.TRANSL: She looked at it and it was still there.

S.FORM: ʔaisi ʔa-pa-kaən-ən=kiai uuru. "kaʔan taavalaʔ-ən makasia, kisa-ən na=cuuma=mia, cuuma miciko, cumpouli.
S.PHON: ʔaiʂi ʔapakaənənkiai uuru kaʔan taavaɾaʔən makaʂia kisaən naʦuumamia ʦuuma mitʂiko ʦumpouɾi
S.FORM: 'aisi 'apakaenenkiai uuru. "ka'an taavara'en makasia, kisaen nacuumamia, cuuma miciko, cumpouri.
S.PHON: ʔaiʂi ʔapakaenenkiai uu[r|ɾ]u kaʔan taava[r|ɾ]aʔen makaʂia kisaen naʦuumamia ʦuuma mitʂiko ʦumpou[r|ɾ]i
S.TRANSL: She fed rice to it. Although Michiko's father Cumpouli said, "Don't do it like this!"

S.FORM: kaʔan paki-turu, maa-kai-naanu.
S.PHON: kaʔan pakituru maakainaanu
S.FORM: ka'an pakituru, maakainaanu.
S.PHON: kaʔan pakitu[r|ɾ]u maakainaanu
S.TRANSL: She would not follow him, and she wouldn't mind.

S.FORM: araanai=cu ʔinia aaka=cu tinaʔan-in mə-sukuam. ni-m-i-kai-naan tinaʔan-in mia-iisua.
S.PHON: araanaiʦu ʔinia aakaʦu tinaʔanin məsukuam nimikainaan tinaʔanin miaiisua
S.FORM: araanaicu 'inia aakacu tina'anin mesukuam. nimikainaan tina'anin miaiisua.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]aanaiʦu ʔinia aakaʦu tinaʔanin mesukuam nimikainaan tinaʔanin miaiisua
S.TRANSL: From then on, her health was poor and she fell sick. How was her body?

S.FORM: sua tinaʔan-in ia, makai=kia ʔuncu lapat-ini karianumai makasua sua capaini.
S.PHON: sua tinaʔanin ia makaikia ʔunʦu ɾapatini karianumai makasua sua ʦapaini
S.FORM: sua tina'anin ia, makaikia 'uncu rapatini karianumai makasua sua capaini.
S.PHON: sua tinaʔanin ia makaikia ʔunʦu [r|ɾ]apatini ka[r|ɾ]ianumai makasua sua ʦapaini
S.TRANSL: As for her body, her skin appeared to be the same color as a pangolin.

S.FORM: nuu tee-ini ara-takarə tia=m-iivu ia, makai karianumai makaisi sua ramuc-ini.
S.PHON: nuu teeini aratakarə tiamiivu ia makai karianumai makaiʂi sua ramutʂini
S.FORM: nuu teeini aratakare tiamiivu ia, makai karianumai makaisi sua ramucini.
S.PHON: nuu teeini a[r|ɾ]ataka[r|ɾ]e tiamiivu ia makai ka[r|ɾ]ianumai makaiʂi sua [r|ɾ]amutʂini
S.TRANSL: When she stood up to urinate, her hands moved like a pangolin.

S.FORM: kaʔan pa-ki-turu pa-li-aluma ʔinia.
S.PHON: kaʔan pakituru paɾiaɾuma ʔinia
S.FORM: ka'an pakituru pariaruma 'inia.
S.PHON: kaʔan pakitu[r|ɾ]u pa[r|ɾ]ia[r|ɾ]uma ʔinia
S.TRANSL: She did not follow (his advice) to release it.

S.FORM: kaʔan mia-ranau ʔakia=cu.
S.PHON: kaʔan miaranau ʔakiaʦu
S.FORM: ka'an miaranau 'akiacu.
S.PHON: kaʔan mia[r|ɾ]anau ʔakiaʦu
S.TRANSL: She was gone before long.

S.FORM: iimu sua iikita kanakanavu ia, ʔakun t<um>ani-ulaʔə karianumai cu-culu puisia t<um>ani-ulaʔə karianumai.
S.PHON: iimu sua iikita kanakanavu ia ʔakun tumaniuɾaʔə karianumai ʦuʦuɾu puiʂia tumaniuɾaʔə karianumai
S.FORM: iimu sua iikita kanakanavu ia, 'akun t<um>aniura'e karianumai cucuru puisia t<um>aniura'e karianumai.
S.PHON: iimu sua iikita kanakanavu ia ʔakun tumaniu[r|ɾ]aʔe ka[r|ɾ]ianumai ʦuʦu[r|ɾ]u puiʂia tumaniu[r|ɾ]aʔe ka[r|ɾ]ianumai
S.TRANSL: The tradition of our Kanakanavu people is not to abuse any pangolins.

FORM.notes: Source parenthetical expanded under POL-026/POL-027; exact source and decision are in source_notation_audit.csv.

S.FORM: iimu sua iikita kanakanavu ia, ʔakun t<um>ani-ulaʔə karianumai cu-culu puisia sua t<um>ani-ulaʔə karianumai.
S.PHON: iimu sua iikita kanakanavu ia ʔakun tumaniuɾaʔə karianumai ʦuʦuɾu puiʂia sua tumaniuɾaʔə karianumai
S.FORM: iimu sua iikita kanakanavu ia, 'akun t<um>aniura'e karianumai cucuru puisia sua t<um>aniura'e karianumai.
S.PHON: iimu sua iikita kanakanavu ia ʔakun tumaniu[r|ɾ]aʔe ka[r|ɾ]ianumai ʦuʦu[r|ɾ]u puiʂia sua tumaniu[r|ɾ]aʔe ka[r|ɾ]ianumai
S.TRANSL: The tradition of our Kanakanavu people is not to abuse any pangolins.

S.FORM: nai, cəʔəra-a iiku ia, ʔapacuaʔ-ai c<um>əʔəra=ku karianumai ia, kaʔan=ku mati-saaʔə.
S.PHON: nai ʦəʔəraa iiku ia ʔapaʦuaʔai ʦuməʔəraku karianumai ia kaʔanku matisaaʔə
S.FORM: nai, ce'eraa iiku ia, 'apacua'ai c<um>e'eraku karianumai ia, ka'anku matisaa'e.
S.PHON: nai ʦeʔe[r|ɾ]aa iiku ia ʔapaʦuaʔai ʦumeʔe[r|ɾ]aku ka[r|ɾ]ianumai ia kaʔanku matisaaʔe
S.TRANSL: Hey, Look! When I see a pangolin, I won't catch it.

S.FORM: puu-kari=ku maamia sumukun a-pati-saaʔə ʔinia ʔuna caini cəʔəra para-cua-cua sumukun.
S.PHON: puukariku maamia sumukun apatisaaʔə ʔinia ʔuna ʦaini ʦəʔəra paraʦuaʦua sumukun
S.FORM: puukariku maamia sumukun apatisaa'e 'inia 'una caini ce'era paracuacua sumukun.
S.PHON: puuka[r|ɾ]iku maamia sumukun apatisaaʔe ʔinia ʔuna ʦaini ʦeʔe[r|ɾ]a pa[r|ɾ]aʦuaʦua sumukun
S.TRANSL: I would only call the Bunun people to catch it, if I should see a couple of them at a distance.

S.FORM: makasua sua si-a-tuuturu=maku kamua.
S.PHON: makasua sua ʂiatuuturumaku kamua
S.FORM: makasua sua siatuuturumaku kamua.
S.PHON: makasua sua ʂiatuutu[r|ɾ]umaku kamua
S.TRANSL: So this is what I'd like to instruct you.

S.FORM: ma-manu=maku, cu-culu karianumai ia, ni-papa-cəvərə Kitana. nain sua ni-papa-cəvərə kitana?
S.PHON: mamanumaku ʦuʦuɾu karianumai ia nipapaʦəvərə kitana nain sua nipapaʦəvərə kitana
S.FORM: mamanumaku, cucuru karianumai ia, nipapacevere Kitana. nain sua nipapacevere kitana?
S.PHON: mamanumaku ʦuʦu[r|ɾ]u ka[r|ɾ]ianumai ia nipapaʦeve[r|ɾ]e kitana nain sua nipapaʦeve[r|ɾ]e kitana
S.TRANSL: Young fellows, Pangolins really keep us alive. Who keeps us alive?

S.FORM: ʔuuna=kita kanakanavu ni-ʔavun-an=cu, taavalaʔə karianumai. mari-takarə sua ni-arəara, mari-takarə sua caau ʔaisi ta-skar-a-ini.
S.PHON: ʔuunakita kanakanavu niʔavunanʦu taavaɾaʔə karianumai maritakarə sua niarəara maritakarə sua ʦaau ʔaiʂi taskaraini
S.FORM: 'uunakita kanakanavu ni'avunancu, taavara'e karianumai. maritakare sua niareara, maritakare sua caau 'aisi taskaraini.
S.PHON: ʔuunakita kanakanavu niʔavunanʦu taava[r|ɾ]aʔe ka[r|ɾ]ianumai ma[r|ɾ]itaka[r|ɾ]e sua nia[r|ɾ]ea[r|ɾ]a ma[r|ɾ]itaka[r|ɾ]e sua ʦaau ʔaiʂi taska[r|ɾ]aini
S.TRANSL: A certain person was already buried. A pangolin knew it and uncovered the coffin by pushing the cover to stand on the side of the coffin. The dead inside the coffin revived and stood up.

S.FORM: maka-sua sua si-a-tuuturu=maku kamua.
S.PHON: makasua sua ʂiatuuturumaku kamua
S.FORM: makasua sua siatuuturumaku kamua.
S.PHON: makasua sua ʂiatuutu[r|ɾ]umaku kamua
S.TRANSL: This is what I'd like to instruct you.

S.FORM: kaa-maŋ-maŋ-təʔai-ini=naku si kaari iisia. tee=pa pasi-ʔəna-ʔəna-ən tee=pa ali-sinatə. tee=pa ali-sinatə ciausoo=maku na sunatə.
S.PHON: kaamaŋmaŋtəʔaiininaku ʂi kaari iiʂia teepa paʂiʔənaʔənaən teepa aɾiʂinatə teepa aɾiʂinatə tʂiausoomaku na sunatə
